parts.zh: 警方报告称,周日早晨一名男子在掀开马桶盖时被一条4英尺长的蛇咬伤
这条蛇没有毒性,因此该男子无需前往医院
接受采访的警官告诉新闻记者
这条蛇最终被当地动物处理人员捕获
多年来,青蛙和鱼等其他生物也曾以各种方式进入马桶
M: 是的。有两种不同的依恋类型:焦虑型依恋和回避型依恋
W: 回避能降低他们的压力水平吗?
M: 并不能。他们的压力水平实际上和那些大喊大叫的孩子经历的压力水平是一样的
W: 我猜这两种都可以被称为不安全型
M: 完全正确。这是一种非常不安全的依恋
W: 不安全型依恋如何影响朋友之间

items.stem: What do we learn from the police report?

choices.text: A man was bitten by a snake.
choices.zh: 一名男子被蛇咬伤。

choices.text: A man was taken to a hospital.
choices.zh: 一名男子被送往医院。

choices.text: A man kept a 4-foot snake as a pet.
choices.zh: 一名男子养了一条4英尺长的蛇作为宠物。

choices.text: A man fell off his toilet seat.
choices.zh: 一名男子从马桶座上摔了下来。

items.stem: What does the report say was still unclear?

choices.text: Where the snake had been taken.
choices.zh: 蛇被带到了哪里。

choices.text: Whether the snake was infected.
choices.zh: 蛇是否被感染。

choices.text: How the snake was captured.
choices.zh: 蛇是如何被捕获的。

choices.text: Who owned the snake.
choices.zh: 蛇的主人是谁。

items.stem: What has Andrea Belcher been doing since last April?

choices.text: Taking her trash out in fancy dresses.
choices.zh: 穿着华丽的礼服去倒垃圾。

choices.text: Amusing herself by going to ball parties.
choices.zh: 通过参加舞会派对来自娱自乐。

choices.text: Sharing her photos with famous movie stars.
choices.zh: 与著名电影明星分享她的照片。

choices.text: Posting her daughter's photos on social media.
choices.zh: 在社交媒体上发布她女儿的照片。

items.stem: Why has Andrea Belcher kept up her videos?

choices.text: To make herself popular.
choices.zh: 为了让自己受欢迎。

choices.text: To amuse people.
choices.zh: 为了逗乐人们。

choices.text: To please her daughter.
choices.zh: 为了取悦她的女儿。

choices.text: To record her achievements.
choices.zh: 为了记录她的成就。

items.stem: What can people do at Frank's restaurant?

choices.text: Eat as much as they want for $10.
choices.zh: 花10美元想吃多少就吃多少。

choices.text: Have a chance of winning a $100 prize.
choices.zh: 有机会赢得100美元的奖金。

choices.text: Have a meal even if they have no money.
choices.zh: 即使没有钱也能吃一顿饭。

choices.text: Get a free meal after answering some questions.
choices.zh: 回答一些问题后获得免费餐食。

items.stem: What does the owner of the restaurant say about the idea for the board of free meals?

choices.text: It was brought up by two staffers.
choices.zh: 这是由两名员工提出的。

choices.text: It helped to popularize her restaurant.
choices.zh: 这帮助推广了她的餐厅。

choices.text: It originated from a donation to her staff.
choices.zh: 这源于一笔给她员工的捐款。

choices.text: It was suggested by some of her customers.
choices.zh: 这是由她的一些顾客建议的。

items.stem: What has happened at Frank's restaurant since the board of free meals was created?

choices.text: Fifty customers have offered donations.
choices.zh: 五十位顾客提供了捐款。

choices.text: More people have been giving than taking.
choices.zh: 付出的人比索取的人更多。

choices.text: Many people have come to eat at the restaurant.
choices.zh: 许多人来这家餐厅吃饭。

choices.text: Most staffers have received messages of kindness.
choices.zh: 大多数员工都收到了善意的留言。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man?

choices.text: He is a psychologist.
choices.zh: 他是一位心理学家。

choices.text: He is a famous writer.
choices.zh: 他是一位著名作家。

choices.text: He is a host for a TV program.
choices.zh: 他是一档电视节目的主持人。

choices.text: He is a primary school teacher.
choices.zh: 他是一位小学教师。

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: Why social media accounts vanish without a trace.
choices.zh: 为什么社交媒体账号会消失得无影无踪。

choices.text: Why parents raise their children in different ways.
choices.zh: 为什么父母以不同方式抚养孩子。

choices.text: Why people fail to respond to emails promptly.
choices.zh: 为什么人们无法及时回复电子邮件。

choices.text: Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.
choices.zh: 为什么朋友会突然断绝联系。

items.stem: How do children with an anxious attachment style react to a breakdown in their relationship with parents?

choices.text: They simply shut themselves down.
choices.zh: 他们只是把自己封闭起来。

choices.text: They avoid showing their emotions.
choices.zh: 他们避免表露自己的情绪。

choices.text: They scream to get their parents back.
choices.zh: 他们通过尖叫来让父母回到身边。

choices.text: They attempt to ignore the whole situation.
choices.zh: 他们试图忽视整个情况。

items.stem: What does the man say about insecurely attached people?

choices.text: They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.
choices.zh: 他们可能把任何分歧都视为一段关系的终结。

choices.text: They are on better terms with friends and romantic partners.
choices.zh: 他们与朋友和恋爱伴侣的关系更好。

choices.text: They try to express their feelings and thoughts effectively.
choices.zh: 他们试图有效地表达自己的感受和想法。

choices.text: They attach more value to their relationships with others.
choices.zh: 他们更加重视与他人的关系。

items.stem: What makes the man choose to buy jeans made in Japan?

choices.text: Their price.
choices.zh: 它们的价格。

choices.text: Their color.
choices.zh: 它们的颜色。

choices.text: Their quality.
choices.zh: 它们的质量。

choices.text: Their design.
choices.zh: 它们的设计。

items.stem: Why is the woman puzzled by the man's request?

choices.text: Jeans are a typical American garment.
choices.zh: 牛仔裤是典型的美国服装。

choices.text: America makes the best-known brands of jeans.
choices.zh: 美国生产最知名品牌的牛仔裤。

choices.text: America has the best weaving tools in the world.
choices.zh: 美国拥有世界上最好的编织工具。

choices.text: Jeans are available in a greater variety in America.
choices.zh: 牛仔裤在美国有更多样化的选择。

items.stem: What does the man say about the dyes of Japanese jeans?

choices.text: They are artificial.
choices.zh: 它们是人工的。

choices.text: They are natural.
choices.zh: 它们是天然的。

choices.text: They are unique.
choices.zh: 它们是独特的。

choices.text: They are special.
choices.zh: 它们是特殊的。

items.stem: What does the man say about Japanese jeans at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: They are for casual wearing.
choices.zh: 它们适合休闲穿着。

choices.text: They are popular with boys.
choices.zh: 它们受男孩们欢迎。

choices.text: They are much too pricey.
choices.zh: 它们太贵了。

choices.text: They are worth the price.
choices.zh: 它们物有所值。

items.stem: How does the speaker feel every time he walks out of a superhero movie?

choices.text: He desires more in life.
choices.zh: 他渴望生活中有更多东西。

choices.text: He wants to see it again.
choices.zh: 他想再看一遍。

choices.text: He feels as inspired as other audience members.
choices.zh: 他感到和其他观众一样受到鼓舞。

choices.text: He longs to become a superstar himself.
choices.zh: 他渴望自己成为超级明星。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the plot of all superhero movies?

choices.text: It is rather unrealistic.
choices.zh: 相当不现实。

choices.text: It is extremely artistic.
choices.zh: 极具艺术性。

choices.text: It is somewhat complicated.
choices.zh: 有些复杂。

choices.text: It is relatively predictable.
choices.zh: 相对可预测。

items.stem: What do the elites of American society think of superhero movies?

choices.text: They are biased against women.
choices.zh: 它们对女性存有偏见。

choices.text: They are basically misleading.
choices.zh: 它们基本上具有误导性。

choices.text: They are full of shootings.
choices.zh: 它们充满枪战场面。

choices.text: They are too simple.
choices.zh: 它们过于简单。

items.stem: What does the passage say about storytelling?

choices.text: It can highlight leadership.
choices.zh: 它能突出领导力。

choices.text: It can help connect people.
choices.zh: 它能帮助连接人们。

choices.text: It is a means to inspire creative thinking.
choices.zh: 它是激发创造性思维的手段。

choices.text: It is an intuitive way to solidify friendship.
choices.zh: 它是巩固友谊的直观方式。

items.stem: What can good stories do to listeners according to the passage?

choices.text: Allow them to recite data points.
choices.zh: 让他们背诵数据要点。

choices.text: Make them more open to learning.
choices.zh: 使他们更愿意学习。

choices.text: Enable them to remember the main idea.
choices.zh: 使他们能够记住主要观点。

choices.text: Stimulate them to engage in discussions.
choices.zh: 激励他们参与讨论。

items.stem: What can leaders do with a simple personal story?

choices.text: Inspire listeners' imagination.
choices.zh: 激发听众的想象力。

choices.text: Convey fundamental values.
choices.zh: 传达基本价值观。

choices.text: Enrich their own experience.
choices.zh: 丰富他们自己的经验。

choices.text: Explain insightful ideas.
choices.zh: 解释富有洞察力的想法。

items.stem: What does the passage say statistics prove?

choices.text: Immigrants outnumber U.S.-born Americans.
choices.zh: 移民人数超过在美国出生的美国人。

choices.text: Immigrants have been contributing to the U.S.
choices.zh: 移民一直在为美国做贡献。

choices.text: Another wave of immigrants is hitting the U.S.
choices.zh: 另一波移民潮正在冲击美国。

choices.text: The number of immigrants to the U.S. is declining.
choices.zh: 移民美国的人数正在下降。

items.stem: What do we learn about immigrants in the U.S., compared with native-born Americans?

choices.text: More of them expect their children to succeed in business.
choices.zh: 他们当中更多人期望自己的孩子在商业上取得成功。

choices.text: They have fewer chances to be hired by U.S. companies.
choices.zh: 他们被美国公司雇用的机会更少。

choices.text: They have founded most Fortune 500 companies.
choices.zh: 他们创立了大多数财富500强公司。

choices.text: More of them are successful business people.
choices.zh: 他们当中更多人是成功的商业人士。

items.stem: What does the passage say about immigrants in the U.S., in terms of financial strength?

choices.text: They have higher installment loan debt than native-born Americans.
choices.zh: 他们的分期贷款债务高于在美国出生的美国人。

choices.text: Nineteen percent of them borrow money from friends and family.
choices.zh: 他们当中有百分之十九的人从朋友和家人那里借钱。

choices.text: Their level of debt is lower than that of native-born Americans.
choices.zh: 他们的债务水平低于在美国出生的美国人。

choices.text: Thirty-four percent of them use credit for their daily purchases.
choices.zh: 他们当中有百分之三十四的人使用信贷进行日常购物。

items.stem: What do immigrants do to achieve their goals in the U.S.?

choices.text: Keep their traditional values and old habits.
choices.zh: 保持他们的传统价值观和旧习惯。

choices.text: Find employment in competitive businesses.
choices.zh: 在竞争激烈的行业中找到工作。

choices.text: Borrow money from financial institutions.
choices.zh: 从金融机构借钱。

choices.text: Collaborate with native-born Americans.
choices.zh: 与在美国出生的美国人合作。
